# Overview

This document computes descriptive statistics of the sample used in the
topographic EEG analyses. Group membership is defined by the MoCA score
(> 25 = HC, ≤ 25 = CI), **not** from the study/ID prefix.

**Data source:** `all_vars_in_one_Korian.xlsx`  
**Sheet:** `"Sheet1"`

---

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# ---- adapt this path ----
file_path  <- "G:/SW Topography/all_vars_in_one_Korian.xlsx"
sheet_name <- "Sheet1"
```

---

# Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet_name)

cat("Columns detected:\n")
print(names(data))

cat("\nFirst 6 rows:\n")
head(data)
```

---

# Prepare Variables

```{r}
#| label: prepare-vars

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    inclusion  = as.numeric(inclusion),
    gender     = tolower(trimws(as.character(gender))),
    age        = as.numeric(age),
    group      = ifelse(MOCA_score > 25, "HC", "CI"),   # MoCA > 25 = HC, ≤ 25 = CI
    is_CI      = group == "CI"
  )
```

---

# Sanity Checks — group correction

```{r}
#| label: group-audit

# Cross-tab: study code vs true group (makes the reclassification explicit)
data %>% filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  mutate(study = substr(ID, 1, 5)) %>%
  count(study, group) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n)

# Corrected group Ns (expect HC = 25, CI = 15)
data %>% filter(inclusion == 1) %>% count(group)

# Clinical label (group_CZ, where available) vs. MoCA-based group
data %>% filter(inclusion == 1) %>% count(group_CZ, group)

# Participants whose clinical label disagrees with the MoCA-based group
data %>% filter(inclusion == 1, !is.na(group_CZ),
                (group_CZ == "Healthy") != (group == "HC")) %>%
  select(ID, group_CZ, MOCA_score, group)

# Safety: no person counted twice among included
data %>% filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  mutate(suffix = sub(".*-", "", ID)) %>%
  count(suffix) %>% filter(n > 1)
```

---

# Overall Sample Statistics

```{r}
#| label: overall-stats

n_total    <- n_distinct(data$ID)
n_included <- data %>% filter(inclusion == 1) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(ID)) %>% pull(n)
n_excluded <- n_total - n_included

cat("===== Overall sample =====\n")
cat("Total participants:    ", n_total,    "\n")
cat("Included participants: ", n_included, "\n")
cat("Excluded participants: ", n_excluded, "\n")
```

---

# Age Descriptives

```{r}
#| label: age-stats

age_stats <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    N      = n_distinct(ID),
    Mean   = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD     = round(sd(age,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = round(median(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min    = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = max(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kable(age_stats, caption = "Age descriptives of included participants") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: age-by-group

age_by_group <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  group_by(Group = group) %>%
  summarise(
    N      = n_distinct(ID),
    Mean   = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD     = round(sd(age,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = round(median(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min    = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = max(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(age_by_group, caption = "Age descriptives by group (included participants)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

---

# Gender Distribution

```{r}
#| label: gender-stats

gender_counts <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  count(gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

kable(gender_counts, col.names = c("Gender", "N", "%"),
      caption = "Gender distribution of included participants") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: gender-by-group

gender_by_group <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  count(Group = group, gender, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

kable(gender_by_group, col.names = c("Group", "Gender", "N", "%"),
      caption = "Gender distribution by group (included participants)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

---

# CI Group Statistics

```{r}
#| label: ci-stats

n_CI_total    <- data %>% filter(group == "CI") %>%                 summarise(n = n_distinct(ID)) %>% pull(n)
n_CI_included <- data %>% filter(group == "CI", inclusion == 1) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(ID)) %>% pull(n)
n_CI_excluded <- n_CI_total - n_CI_included

cat("===== CI group =====\n")
cat("Total CI participants:    ", n_CI_total,    "\n")
cat("Included CI participants: ", n_CI_included, "\n")
cat("Excluded CI participants: ", n_CI_excluded, "\n")
```

---

# Compact Summary Table (for paper)

```{r}
#| label: paper-table

paper_table <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  group_by(Group = group) %>%
  summarise(
    N              = n_distinct(ID),
    `Age M (SD)`   = paste0(round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                             " (", round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),
    `Age range`    = paste0(min(age, na.rm = TRUE), "–", max(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Female n (%)` = {
                       f <- sum(gender %in% c("female", "f", "w", "weiblich"), na.rm = TRUE)
                       paste0(f, " (", round(f / n() * 100, 1), "%)")
                     },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

total_row <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    Group          = "Total",
    N              = n_distinct(ID),
    `Age M (SD)`   = paste0(round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                             " (", round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"),
    `Age range`    = paste0(min(age, na.rm = TRUE), "–", max(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Female n (%)` = {
                       f <- sum(gender %in% c("female", "f", "w", "weiblich"), na.rm = TRUE)
                       paste0(f, " (", round(f / n() * 100, 1), "%)")
                     }
  )

paper_table <- bind_rows(paper_table, total_row)

kable(paper_table, caption = "Sample characteristics of included participants") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(paper_table), bold = TRUE)
```

---

# Publication-Ready Flextable

```{r}
#| label: participant-table

demo <- data %>%
  filter(inclusion == 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))          # keep only classified, included participants

p_ttest <- function(var, grp) t.test(var ~ grp)$p.value
p_fisher <- function(var, grp) fisher.test(table(var, grp))$p.value   # Fisher's exact test

HC <- demo %>% filter(group == "HC")
CI <- demo %>% filter(group == "CI")

n_hc     <- nrow(HC)
n_ci     <- nrow(CI)
male_hc  <- sum(HC$gender %in% c("m", "male", "männlich"), na.rm = TRUE)
male_ci  <- sum(CI$gender %in% c("m", "male", "männlich"), na.rm = TRUE)
fem_hc   <- sum(HC$gender %in% c("f", "female", "w", "weiblich"), na.rm = TRUE)
fem_ci   <- sum(CI$gender %in% c("f", "female", "w", "weiblich"), na.rm = TRUE)

rows <- tribble(
  ~Variable, ~HC_M,              ~HC_SD, ~CI_M,             ~CI_SD, ~p,
  "N",        n_hc,               NA,     n_ci,              NA,     NA,
  "Male",     male_hc,            NA,     male_ci,           NA,     NA,
  "Female",   fem_hc,             NA,     fem_ci,            NA,     p_fisher(demo$gender, demo$group),
  "Age",      mean(HC$age, na.rm=TRUE), sd(HC$age, na.rm=TRUE), mean(CI$age, na.rm=TRUE), sd(CI$age, na.rm=TRUE), p_ttest(demo$age, demo$group),
)
```

```{r}
#| label: extra-vars-stats

# NOTE: confirm these column names match your sheet (MOCA_score / PSQI_Score / Education)
extra_rows <- tribble(
  ~Variable,    ~HC_M,                             ~HC_SD,                        ~CI_M,                             ~CI_SD,                        ~p,
  "MoCA",       mean(HC$MOCA_score, na.rm=TRUE),   sd(HC$MOCA_score, na.rm=TRUE), mean(CI$MOCA_score, na.rm=TRUE),   sd(CI$MOCA_score, na.rm=TRUE), t.test(MOCA_score ~ group, data=demo)$p.value,
  "PSQI",       mean(HC$PSQI_Score, na.rm=TRUE),   sd(HC$PSQI_Score, na.rm=TRUE), mean(CI$PSQI_Score, na.rm=TRUE),   sd(CI$PSQI_Score, na.rm=TRUE), t.test(PSQI_Score ~ group, data=demo)$p.value,
  "Education",  mean(HC$Education,  na.rm=TRUE),   sd(HC$Education,  na.rm=TRUE), mean(CI$Education,  na.rm=TRUE),   sd(CI$Education,  na.rm=TRUE), wilcox.test(Education ~ group, data=demo)$p.value,
)

all_rows <- bind_rows(rows, extra_rows)

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", formatC(round(p, 2), 2, format = "f")))

table_df <- all_rows %>%
  mutate(
    HC_M  = ifelse(row_number() <= 3,
                   ifelse(is.na(HC_M), "", as.character(as.integer(HC_M))),
                   ifelse(is.na(HC_M), "", formatC(round(HC_M, 2), 2, format = "f"))),
    HC_SD = ifelse(is.na(HC_SD), "", formatC(round(HC_SD, 2), 2, format = "f")),
    CI_M  = ifelse(row_number() <= 3,
                   ifelse(is.na(CI_M), "", as.character(as.integer(CI_M))),
                   ifelse(is.na(CI_M), "", formatC(round(CI_M, 2), 2, format = "f"))),
    CI_SD = ifelse(is.na(CI_SD), "", formatC(round(CI_SD, 2), 2, format = "f")),
    p     = fmt_p(p)
  )

# 95% CI of the mean (t distribution), requested by Reviewer 1
m_ci <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; m <- mean(x)
  h <- qt(.975, length(x) - 1) * sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
  sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", m, m - h, m + h)
}
vars <- c("age", "MOCA_score", "PSQI_Score", "Education")   # rows 4–7: Age, MoCA, PSQI, Education
table_df$HC_M[4:7] <- sapply(vars, function(v) m_ci(HC[[v]]))
table_df$CI_M[4:7] <- sapply(vars, function(v) m_ci(CI[[v]]))

```

```{r}
#| label: render-table

ft <- flextable(table_df) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Variable = "", HC_M = "M [95% CI]", HC_SD = "SD",
    CI_M = "M [95% CI]", CI_SD = "SD", p = "p"
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values    = c("", "HC group", "CI group", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 2, 2, 1)
  ) %>%
  hline(i = 1, j = 2:3, part = "header", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%
  hline(i = 1, j = 4:5, part = "header", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%
  hline_top(part = "header",    border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body",   border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1.5)) %>%
  border_inner_h(border = fp_border(width = 0)) %>%
  border_inner_v(border = fp_border(width = 0)) %>%
  italic(i = 2, j = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6), part = "header") %>%
  bold(i = 1, part = "body") %>%
  align(j = 1,   align = "left",   part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:6, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  width(j = 1,   width = 1.6) %>%
  width(j = c(2, 4), width = 1.6) %>%
  width(j = c(3, 5), width = 0.6) %>%
  width(j = 6,   width = 0.5) %>%
  set_caption("Table 1. Characteristics of participants")

ft
```

```{r}
#| label: export-table

save_as_docx(ft, path = "participant_table.docx")
cat("Table exported to participant_table.docx\n")
```
